sources.title: Upscale: Increase Resolution · Photoshop AI Plugin · Seam
sources.snippet: The Upscale tab increases the resolution of an image. The models rebuild detail at the larger size instead of stretching pixels. This is useful for print, tight crops, or older material. How to upscale 1 Select the layer you want to enlarge, or make a selection. 2 Choose an upscale model and set the scale factor or a target resolution.
